status: twelve new dense-forest tiles prepared for visual review
owner_request: Пойдёт. Теперь делай хвойные и смешанные леса. Пока без разреженных. Всех видов. Также в итоге2d4 карту в конце покажи со всеми гексами.
art_requirements: Preserve accepted deciduous terrain shapes, upright art, common tree-height scale, grass background assignment and dense canopy.
Coniferous forests use clear tapered evergreen pine/spruce crowns with a few broad tiers, rather than needle microtexture.
Mixed forests request approximately40–60% of each tree family, naturally interspersed through foreground, center and background.
Trees, hill domes and mountain ridges remain opaque and crisp. Only the ground color, forest-floor soil and ground shadows softly merge into grass.
Tall peripheral conifers are rooted deeper inside the full regular hex so complete tips and branches fit; no extra clipped hex tips or broad river reserve.
Grass is the shared background assignment; pixel-identical painted background colors between variants are not claimed.
export: 210x210 RGB/sRGB PNG without alpha; generated square resized whole, without added blur/sharpen filters. Hex clipping is only applied in map/contact previews.
validation: Twelve square sources and PNG formats checked. Visual reviews at210px,60px and in both map orientations assess clarity, density, biome distinction and complete-object fit. Outside-dark-green metric is a heuristic, not exact foreground segmentation.
